_comment: Copy to application_profile.json (gitignored) and fill in. Used by .agents/skills/ats-autofill to prefill application forms. Anything left null is simply not filled, and the CLI reports it so you fill it in by hand.

workAuthorization._comment: Both booleans are required. authorizedUS = can work in the US today. requiresSponsorship = will need sponsorship now or in the future. The CLI resolves question polarity from these two, so getting them right matters more than any other field.

eeo._comment: Voluntary self-identification. 'Decline to self-identify' is the default and is always a valid answer. Set real values only if you want them submitted.

preferences._comment: desiredSalary and currentSalary stay null on purpose. A blank compensation box is a stronger negotiating position than a number you typed before you knew the range.

documents._comment: Paths relative to the repo root, or absolute. Override per application with --resume / --cover.

answers._comment: Free-text answers keyed by a distinctive substring of the question label, lowercased. Matched by substring, so keep keys short and specific.
